model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  Attitude =~ att_appealing + att_desirable +
              att_goodidea + att_pleasant
  PBC =~ pbc_barrier + pbc_could +
         pbc_resources
  SocialNorms =~ norms_d_many + norms_d_common +
                  norms_d_few + 
                  norms_i_consider + norms_i_bad +
                  norms_i_support


  Symbolism =~ symb_envresp + symb_modern
  EnvOrientation =~ aoc_transport + aoc_overstated + aoc_minor + ben_env_reduce + ben_env_shift + ben_env_nodiff
  
  Inst_trust =~ reactance_interfere + reactance_rulesharm + reactance_commongood + reactance_individual + 
                antiintel_commonsense + antiintel_facts + antiintel_expertshelp

  Intention =~ nextv_bev + nextv_phev + nextv_icev

  # Reflective utility constructs
  RngCompat =~ fit_hh_prosp_fit +
                    fit_hh_prosp_plan +
                    fit_hh_prosp_shortnotice +
                    fit_hh_prosp_emergency + range_prosp_routine +
                     range_prosp_longtrip +
                     range_prosp_cold +
                     range_prosp_hills

  EVSE_perc =~ find_evse_prosp_nearby +
               find_evse_prosp_longtrip +
               find_evse_prosp_schedule

  Observability =~ observ_evs +
                   observ_charging +
                   observ_stations
                   
  PowerPerc =~ bev_better_towing +
             bev_better_roughroad +
             bev_better_accel +
             bev_better_power
  
  NonPowerPerc =~ bev_better_comfort +
               bev_better_safety +
               bev_better_reliability

  # =======================================
  # Structural path
  # ======================================= 
  Intention ~ Attitude + PBC + SocialNorms  
  Attitude ~  EnvOrientation + Symbolism + Inst_trust + RngCompat + Observability + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc + NonPowerPerc + cost_comp + trial_comp
  PBC ~ RngCompat + EVSE_perc + PowerPerc  + cost_comp + trial_comp
  SocialNorms ~  Symbolism + Observability

 

  # =======================================
  # Covariance path
  # ======================================= 
  Attitude ~~ PBC
  Attitude ~~ SocialNorms
  SocialNorms ~~ PBC

  SocialNorms ~~ EnvOrientation
  
  EnvOrientation ~~ PBC
  EnvOrientation ~~ Symbolism
  
  EnvOrientation ~~ Inst_trust

  
  # New endo ~~ exo paths in the presence of dispositional account
  SocialNorms ~~ Inst_trust

  
  # New exo~endo paths due to the presence of new utility exo vars
  SocialNorms ~~ PowerPerc
  SocialNorms ~~ NonPowerPerc
  SocialNorms ~~ RngCompat
  SocialNorms ~~ EVSE_perc

  # In addition, all exo ~~ exo allowed with auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE
